eod.conclusion: Markets showed divergent sector performance with benchmarks ending mixed. While the Sensex eked out modest gains, the Nifty and Bank Nifty slipped slightly, reflecting financial sector weakness. The session saw early enthusiasm fade by close, though reduced volatility supported a third straight day of advances for major indices. Corporate earnings reports drove stock-specific action, with severe reactions to disappointing results contrasting with the broader index resilience. Regulatory developments and macroeconomic crosscurrents added layers to the trading narrative.
